purpose: Verified model-level image registry for MotoWorth. Visual-only; never influences valuation.

source_policy.primary: Wikimedia Commons files with reusable licenses after model identity and license review.
source_policy.secondary: Manufacturer-owned media only with explicit reuse permission or approved source agreement.
source_policy.rule: Never silently substitute a visually similar motorcycle.
source_policy.fallback: Show a placeholder until a model image is verified.
